gbm_population_evidence.quote: Assessment Of A Novel Metabolic Imaging Modalities As A Predictor Of Therapeutic Efficacy In Glioblastoma (GBM)

candidate_evidence.quote: \[6,6-²H₂\]-Glucose is a stable isotope-labeled glucose used as a metabolic tracer. It is administered orally to assess glucose metabolism using Deuterium Metabolic Imaging (DMI).
Any participant that consents to entry into the Phase II BPM31510 parent study (BPM31510IV-11)

candidate_flag.reason: BPM31510 is given in the linked parent study, not as a registered intervention here; if the adjudicator counts it as an agent every patient receives, it would be a candidate and S6 would change.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The goal of this study is to evaluate the prognostic capacity of DMI in a trial assessing the efficacy of adding BPM31510, a lipid nano dispersion of CoQ10 to standard treatment of Glioblastoma (GBM).

role_evidence.quote: \[6,6-²H₂\]-Glucose is a stable isotope-labeled glucose used as a metabolic tracer. It is administered orally to assess glucose metabolism using Deuterium Metabolic Imaging (DMI).

agents.drug_class_hint: deuterium-labelled glucose metabolic imaging tracer (stable isotope, not radioactive) for deuterium metabolic imaging

coder_notes: Imaging companion study: the only registered intervention is a deuterated glucose tracer (diagnostic_agent). BPM31510 (lipid nanodispersion of CoQ10 / ubidecarenone) is the investigational drug of the separate parent study BPM31510IV-11 and is not a registered intervention here, so it was not listed (R9); flagged for adjudication. Gadolinium mentioned only as optional routine contrast, not listed. Primary outcomes PFS/OS relate to the parent treatment. Treatment setting not stated (standard treatment of GBM only).
